en: A block and tackle pulley with four supporting rope segments multiplies the input force by exactly four times to lift a heavy load.
The coefficient of kinetic friction between rubber tires and dry asphalt is about 0.7, but it drops to just 0.1 on wet ice.
The acceleration due to gravity on the Moon is 1.6 meters per second squared, which is roughly one-sixth of Earth's 9.8 meters per second squared.
A neodymium magnet can lift up to 1,000 times its own weight, whereas a standard ceramic refrigerator magnet lifts only about 0.1 kilograms.
A typical cloud-to-ground lightning bolt carries about 300 million volts, which is roughly 1.3 million times stronger than a standard 230-volt Philippine household outlet.
Visible red light has a wavelength of about 700 nanometers, making it nearly twice as long as the 400-nanometer wavelength of visible violet light.
Sound travels through water at approximately 1,480 meters per second, which is more than four times faster than its 343 meters per second speed in air.
Water requires about 4.18 joules of heat energy per gram to increase by one degree Celsius, needing about five times more energy than dry sand.
If a car doubles its speed from 30 to 60 kilometers per hour, its kinetic energy increases by exactly four times, not just two times.
A standard wood screw with 10 threads per centimeter requires ten times more turns to drive in than a screw with only 1 thread per centimeter.
Earth's escape velocity is 11.2 kilometers per second, meaning a rocket must travel over 40,000 kilometers per hour to break free from Earth's gravity.
The world's strongest continuous electromagnet reached 45.5 teslas, which is nearly 1 million times stronger than the Earth's natural magnetic field of 0.00005 teslas.
